title: 2022 HMMT November Guts Problem 4
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a square of side length 2 . Let points \(X, Y\), and \(Z\) be constructed inside \(A B C D\) such that \(A B X, B C Y\), and \(C D Z\) are equilateral triangles. Let point \(W\) be outside \(A B C D\) such that triangle \(D A W\) is equilateral. Let the area of quadrilateral \(W X Y Z\) be \(a+\sqrt{b}\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers. Find \(a+b\).

solutions.text: \(W X Y Z\) is a kite with diagonals \(X Z\) and \(W Y\), which have lengths \(2 \sqrt{3}-2\) and 2 , so the area is \(2 \sqrt{3}-2=\sqrt{12}-2\).
